descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]核心内部有什么东西开始稳定地脉动，定期使地面产生轻微的颤动。那像是心跳一般的声音几乎令人感到宽慰。

但我们担心那声音可能变得越来越大。地质学家正在密切监测星球，留意危险的地质运动。
descriptions.en:
Something deep within the core of [From.GetName] has begun to pulsate at a steady pace, sending gentle ripples through the ground at regular intervals. It gives off a soft almost soothing sound, similar to that of a heart beating.

Concerns have been raised, however, that the sound may be growing in strength. Geologists are monitoring the planet closely for signs of dangerous seismic activity.

descriptions.zh:
仅仅过了一年之久，在[hatchling_egg.GetName]上新成立的殖民地就发生了一系列灾难性的大地震，将地貌变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

这种地震现象通常是由地幔内的岩浆流造成的，但在[From.GetName]上根本没有地震活动，除了从地核里发出的不祥震动之外。当地行政机构已开始怀疑殖民地的长期可行性。
descriptions.en:
Barely a year old, the newly established colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has been shaken by a series of devastating earthquakes that are transforming the environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gasses and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Such seismological phenomena are typically caused by magma currents in a planet's mantle but on [From.GetName] there are no indications of seismic activity at all, except for the ominous pounding from the planet's core. Local authorities are beginning to question the colony's viability in the long-term.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]正在经历一系列地震变化，将原本美丽的环境变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

卫星数据显示地核深处在发出强烈的声波能源，就好象心跳一般。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] is going through a series of rapid seismic changes that are transforming the formerly pristine environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gasses and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Satellite data shows strong bursts of sonic energy pulsating from the planet's inner core, as from a heart beating.

tooltips.zh: 地震波撕裂了殖民地，摧毁了所有建筑并留下了§Y裂隙§!。
tooltips.en: Seismic waves have torn through the colony, leveling all buildings and leaving §YRifts§! in their wake.

descriptions.zh:
一阵猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化恐怕无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。当地行政机构已宣布进入紧急情况，并要求所有剩余的居民进行疏散。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
descriptions.en:
A shockwave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], rupturing the lithosphere and expelling a blanket of toxic gasses and sludge, that is now smothering all living things.

We fear the changes on [hatchling_egg.GetName] are irreversible and substantial enough that the planet will be uninhabitable within a near future. Local authorities have declared a state of emergency and request that all remaining inhabitants be evacuated.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

descriptions.zh:
又一场猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
descriptions.en:
Another shock wave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], cracking the lithosphere open and expelling more toxic gasses and sludge that now blanket the surface, smothering all living things.

The changes to [hatchling_egg.GetName] are both irreversible and substantial enough to render the planet uninhabitable within a near future.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

tooltips.zh: 地震波撕裂了殖民地，摧毁了所有建筑并留下了§Y裂隙§!。
tooltips.en: Seismic waves have torn through the colony, leveling all buildings and leaving §YRifts§! in their wake.

descriptions.zh: 灾难降临在了[hatchling_egg.GetName]的殖民地上！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了殖民地的残骸，空壳之下，一只可怕的虚空孳孽幼体如梦魇一般降临！这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在那颗蛋已经孵化了。
descriptions.en: Disaster has befallen the colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName]! A final sequence of violent ruptures has razed the last remains of the settlement and cracked the planet open, and from its empty shell is bursting the nightmarish form of a newborn Voidspawn. It goes against all sense, still there is no other way to explain it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, and that egg has now hatched.

descriptions.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]已经不存在了！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了这颗行星，一只巨大到难以想像的怪兽幼体从星球内破壳而出。

这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在一只噩梦般的虚空孳孽已经孵化了出来。
descriptions.en:
[hatchling_egg.GetName] is no more! A final sequence of violent ruptures has cracked the planet open and from its empty shell crawls the newborn form of a creature of unimaginable proportions.

It goes against all sense, still there is no other way of explaining it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, that has now hatched a nightmarish Voidspawn into the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。

我们现在只能重建损失。
descriptions.en:
The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

All that remains now is to rebuild what was lost.

descriptions.zh: [hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。
descriptions.en: The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的毒性粘液已被清除，而最后一道裂隙也已被填上，以防止更多毒性液体泄漏至地表。
descriptions.en: The toxic sludge on [Root.GetName] has been cleared and the last rifts filled, preventing more noxious gases from leaking to the surface.

descriptions.zh: 一只巨大到难以想像的怪物，正在小心翼翼地从一颗星球移动到另一颗星球。从其别扭的比例与笨拙的身手来看，它还只是个幼崽，但仍然同样可怕。它身上粘着一丝丝的黑色黏液，利爪从其掌间伸出。无论幼崽与否，它都是一只天性凶猛的捕食者。
descriptions.en: A creature of unthinkable size is fluttering clumsily from planet to planet. Judging by its awkward proportions and movements it is only a spawn yet, but it is horrifying to behold all the same. Strings of slime and black bile cling to its body and sharp mandibles. Spawn or not, it is a predator, equipped to kill.

descriptions.zh:
虚空孳孽蜷曲的身体发出一阵轻微的震颤，黑色液体从其伤口与鼻口中泄出，接着它便消逝了，眼睛茫然地凝视着虚空。

但愿我们永远不会见到它生长至成年期的样子，或是其生母的所在之处。

我们的科学家对研究其蛋壳保留能源的独特能力表示很感兴趣。
descriptions.en:
A light tremor passes through the Voidspawn's curled up body, ribbons of black fluid trailing from its wounds and snout, then it is gone, its liquid eyes staring emptily into space.

Hopefully we will never know the form it might have taken if allowed to reach adulthood, or the whereabouts of its originator.

Our scientists have expressed an interest in researching the egg shards for their unique energy retaining qualities.

label.zh: 别。我们不想再与虚空孳孽有任何牵扯。
label.en: No. We are done with the Voidspawn.

descriptions.zh: 我们的死灵法师将躯体装回它原来所在的卵中，孵化了新的§Y虚空孳孽§!以效力于我们的事业。
descriptions.en: Our necromancers returned the body to the egg from which it came, and hatched the §YVoidspawn§! anew to serve our cause.

descriptions.zh:
将§Y虚空孳孽§!装回卵中并再次将其孵化的操作竟然极其地有效。利用卵中残留的原生物质，我们的死灵[root.GetNecromancersLower]可以轻易地编辑这具躯骸来服务我们。

将这只生物制成提线木偶后，我们现在可以扇动它的翅膀了。
descriptions.en:
Returning the §YVoidspawn§! to its egg and incubating it again proved to be incredibly efficient. By making use of the primordial matter still inside the egg, our [root.GetNecromancersLower] easily edited the corpse to service us.

With the creature thus puppeteered, we now flex it's wings.

descriptions.zh: 通过实施死灵机师协议，我们可以复活已死的§Y虚空孳孽§!，替代性翅膀已经由实验性生化合金铸成。
descriptions.en: Utilizing Mechromancy protocols, we have been able to reanimate the terminated §YVoidspawn§!. Replacement wings have been forged using an experimental bio-alloy.

descriptions.zh: 在仔细研究蛋壳碎片之后，我们开发出了一种科技，可以使我们的太阳能电厂获得类似虚空孳孽之卵的能源保留能力。
descriptions.en: A closer analysis of the egg shards has allowed us to develop a technology that will reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities in our own solar plants.

descriptions.zh:
我们面临着一个抉择：

如果我们对蛋的碎片进行近距离分析，我们便有可能再现一些虚空孳孽卵的非凡的能量固存特性。

或者是我们可以保存好虚空孳孽的基因物质以备未来使用。
descriptions.en:
We are faced with a choice:

If we conduct a closer analysis of the egg shards, we could potentially reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities.

Alternatively, we can preserve the genetic material of the Voidspawn for future use.

tooltips.zh: 解锁用于§Y星神兽转基因§!的§Y虚体化§!特质。

descriptions.zh:
我们科研船最近一直在分析那个来自系外的声波信号，现在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科研团队终于取得了突破性进展。

尽管信号中的大部分声波方程的含义我们仍不清楚，但我们母星上的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj][Root.GetScientistPlural]们已经确定该传输信号的数据与神秘§HL-星门§!上所用的科技数据是完全一致的！

单独进行分析的话，此信号的价值近乎为零，但如果将此信号与我们得到的关于远古传送门建造者的信息结合起来进行研究的话，可能就会让我们知道该如何重新启动这些L-星门。
descriptions.en:
Something of a breakthrough has been reached within the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientific community regarding the extragalactic sonified signal one of our Science Ships recently analyzed.

While the full meaning of the sonified equation embedded in the signal still eludes us, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] [Root.GetScientistPlural] on our home world have been able to match enough of the transmission's data on subspace harmonics to the technology observed in the mysterious §HL-Gates§!!

Examined in isolation, the signal is of little further use to us. Analyzing it in conjunction with other insights into the ancient Gateway Builders, however, may yield valuable data on how these L-Gates could be reactivated.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现神秘容器上面的外星化合物是由纳米机器人的粉末组成的。外壳上的一些划痕中甚至有微小的机械爪痕，其中一个爪痕上有个纳米机器人正在从储存器中吸取能源。我们从纳米机器人的存储设备中提取到了一些数据，这些数据可以帮助我们更好地理解L-星团的传送门网络。
descriptions.en: We have discovered that the alien compound found on the enigmatic cache is made up of the powdered fragments of microscopic robotic entities - nanites. Some of the scratches in the hull even have tiny mechanical claws stuck in them, and in one we discovered an active but damaged nanite leeching its energy from the cache. From what remained of the nanite's hard drive we have extracted data that could be pivotal for our understanding of the L-cluster Gateway network.

descriptions.zh:
从[big_rip_planet.GetName]的废墟中回收的众多物品中有一个全息图像，该全息图像来自于某个对植物类[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]生活进行干涉的社会。虽然全息图像中的大部分数据已经损坏的难以辨识，我们还是成功的恢复了几个含有关于传送门网络的关键信息的片段。

大部分全息图像似乎是用来警告灰色风暴将会带来的毁灭性灾难的。
descriptions.en:
Among the items recovered from the ruins on [big_rip_planet.GetName] was a malfunctioning hologram from the society that interfered with the plantoid [GetPreFTLLowerPlural]. Though most of the data was either corrupted or unintelligible due to an incessant whooshing sound and the panicked state of the sender, we managed to restore several fragments containing valuable information on the Gateway network.

Most of the hologram, however, was dedicated to sickening premonitions of the Gray Tempest and the gruesome death that would follow in its wake.

descriptions.zh:
出于安全考虑，我们给所有从西万实验室返回的船员们都进行了全面的消毒，在消毒过程中，我们发现船员的防护外套上面附有某种外星物质，经过仔细研究发现这是某种变成了灰色尘埃的微型机器人碎片。最后我们在这些外星物质中找到了一个完整的纳米机器人，该机器人身上携带着给某个建筑安装螺栓的指令，我们认为那个建筑应该是一个传送门。

这个纳米机器人从事的工作应该是“组装整个L-星门网络”这一系统工程中的一小部分。
descriptions.en:
As the crew returning from the Xvan labs were decontaminated we identified an alien substance on their protective wear. Upon closer examination it has proven to be fragments of microscopic robots turned into a fine gray dust. Among the samples we found an intact nanite carrying instructions for attaching bolts to a structure we believe could be a Gateway.

This molecular construct maybe have had an integral part in assembling the entire L-Gate network.

descriptions.zh: 虽然当时并不明显，但[From.GetName]最近进行的勘探，在报告传回[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学界之后，似乎使§HL-星门§!谜团的研究有了突破性的进展。
descriptions.en: It was not immediately apparent at the time, but the recent survey carried out by the [From.GetName] seemingly sparked a breakthrough in the ongoing study of the mysterious §HL-Gates§! when the report filtered back to the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
虽然我们已经掌握了不少关于L-星门的知识和科技，但目前我们手中并没有L-星门。

如果我们要继续进行计划的话，就必须从某个星系中取得L-星门的控制权。
descriptions.en:
Although we have accumulated a lot of information about the L-Gates and their technology, we are not in possession of an actual gate.

Before this project can continue, we must gain ownership of a system with an L-Gate.

label.zh: 那我们就想办法控制一个L-星门好了。
label.en: Then we shall secure an L-Gate.

label.zh: 虽然听上去挺有意思，但我们不能再让这种事情分散我们的精力了。
label.en: An interesting diversion, but it ends now.

descriptions.zh:
我们已对L-星门有了足够的认知，可以开始研究其背后的科技。研究完成之后，我们应该可以派一艘科研船来中断其无限维护循环。

L-星团已经触手可及了！
descriptions.en:
We have now gathered sufficient L-Gate insights to research the technology behind them. Once this has been done, one of our Science Ships should be able to abort the perpetual maintenance cycle they are stuck in.

The L-Cluster is almost within our reach!

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于§H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the §H[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]§! system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

As the maintenance cycle ends, any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years as their self-correcting software readjusts. Still, this will give us a significant headstart to explore the cluster without interference.

descriptions.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！
descriptions.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy!

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的§HL-星团§!了。

但这样一来，我们就无法启动我们这个星系的L-星门了。现在除了已经可以正常使用的那个L-星门之外，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。

现在如果我们想前往遥远星团的话，只能使用[From.GetName]掌控之下的那个传送门了！
descriptions.en:
The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant §HL-Cluster§!.

Unfortunately, this has halted our own project to activate an L-Gate. Aside from the one that is functional, all other L-Gates in the galaxy have now activated some sort of self-correcting software that should terminate their maintenance cycles within a matter of years.

For now, however, the only way to reach the star cluster is through the gate belonging to the [From.GetName]!

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
descriptions.en:
The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

descriptions.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。
descriptions.en: By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the §H[From.GetName]§! has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

descriptions.zh:
我方特工报告称，§H[lgate_warning_country.GetName]§!手中掌握的情报与信息，距离打开他们控制下的L-星门已经只有一步之遥。这样一来，他们就会取得L-星团的所有秘密与使用权限！

如果想抢先一步，我们就必须着力研究L-星门，尽快掌握它的内幕！
descriptions.en:
Our spies report that the §H[lgate_warning_country.GetName]§! is close to possessing enough information about the L-Gates to unlock the one they control. This would give them access to the L-Cluster and its secrets!

If we are to get there first, we must double our efforts and find more insights into the L-Gates!

label.zh: 那么就看看我们谁比较快吧。
label.en: We shall see who gets there first.

descriptions.zh:
我们打开了通往L-星团的大门，却发现另一边有什么东西在等着我们。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为§YL-星龙§!的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是§Y[dragons_target.GetName]星系§!。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
descriptions.en:
We pried open the gate to the L-Cluster, only to find something waiting for us on the other side. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gates had been fully stabilized, it broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the §YL-Drake§! has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the §Y[dragons_target.GetName] system§!.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

descriptions.zh:
[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系内的L-星门开启了，传送门网络似乎被另一个帝国打开了。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为§YL-星龙§!的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是§Y[dragons_target.GetName]星系§!。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
descriptions.en:
The L-Gate in the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system has become active, the network seemingly pried open by a foreign state. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gate had fully stabilized, something broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the §YL-Drake§! has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the §Y[dragons_target.GetName] system§!.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

descriptions.zh:
传感器侦测到数个同步的亚空间扰动，最近的一个位于[disturbance_system.GetName]星系。

扰动正在迅速减弱，但我们仍未判明造成扰动的原因。
descriptions.en:
Sensors indicate several synchronous subspace disruptions, the closest one reported in the [disturbance_system.GetName] system.

The disturbances are rapidly subsiding, but we have yet to determine what caused them.

descriptions.zh:
§YL-星龙§!已被消灭，而我们的科学家已经开始分析其仍留着温度的遗骸。

有趣的是，它的细胞内完全没有传统的遗传标记，或是任何像是DNA的东西。每个细胞似乎都是在分子水平上单独组成的，然后构成了我们所见到的从L-星门中出现的生物。报告表明在龙的脑干中发现了少量停止的纳米机器，进一步暗示了其荒诞的起源。
descriptions.en:
The §YL-Drake§! has been slain, and our scientists are beginning to tear into its still-warm carcass.

Interestingly, the creature's cells are completely devoid of traditional genetic markers or indeed anything resembling DNA. Each cell appears to have been put together individually, at the molecular level, and then assembled into the creature we saw emerge from the L-Gate. Reports indicate trace amounts of inactive nanomachines in the dragon's brainstem, which further hints at a truly bizarre origin.

descriptions.zh: 被消灭的龙与我们之前遭遇的任何太空生物在分类学上都没有明显的联系。光谱分析同时也显示，它要么是先前在附近星系中观察到的亚空间扰动的原因，要么是其结果。
descriptions.en: The slain dragon has no obvious taxonomic link to any other spaceborne life that we have previously encountered. It is also, spectral analysis tells us, either the cause or the effect of the subspace disruption previously observed in a system not far from here.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]进入了[From.GetName]星系，并正在观察环绕恒星飞行的L星龙。

这只生物似乎迷路了，但注意到了我们舰船的存在。尽管它没有靠近，它环绕飞行的路线中现在包括了几乎是嬉戏一般的俯冲与飞掠，似乎是在向[Root.GetName]示意。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has entered the [From.GetName] system and is observing the L-Drake circling the star.

The creature seems lost, but has noted our vessel's presence. While it does not approach, its circuitous route now incorporates an almost playful plunge and sweep, seemingly directed at the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 或许我们可以与它沟通。
label.en: Perhaps we can communicate with it.

descriptions.zh:
奇怪的是，L-星龙对使用敌我识别系统的波长的通讯广播有很强的接收反应。

科学专员[From.GetLeaderName]开发出了一套L-星龙可以解读并乐于执行的复杂指令——这样它就不至于因为对我们的科研船感兴趣而频繁的与舰体发生冲撞了。
descriptions.en:
Oddly enough, the L-Drake responds well to transmissions broadcast at wavelengths usually reserved for IFF systems.

Science Officer [From.GetLeaderName] has developed a fairly sophisticated set of commands that the L-Drake is able to interpret and will happily execute - in exchange for the occasional friendly wrestling match with one of our Science Ships.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[wormhole_system.GetName]§!星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"§H虫洞§!"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
descriptions.en:
We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the §H[wormhole_system.GetName]§! system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "§Hwormhole§!" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculate, may provide a conduit through subspace to another wormhole located somewhere else in our galaxy.

Depending on where the second wormhole is located, this could potentially allow ships to travel from one end of the galaxy to the other in a matter of days. Unfortunately, this wormhole, like the vast majority of its kind, is inherently unstable. Any vessels foolish enough to pass through it would be ripped apart in seconds.

label.zh: 如果我们能将其稳定的话……
label.en: If it could somehow be stabilized...

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个§H星门§!之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
descriptions.en:
An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "§HGateway§!" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of similar stations that at some point would have allowed for near-instantaneous travel between different parts of the galaxy.

Assuming this is a Gateway, its current state of disrepair has rendered it unusable. If it could be restored into working order, its owner would potentially be able to access any other functional gateways in the galaxy, enabling travel across huge distances in a matter of days.

descriptions.zh: 我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系中。和之前的传送门不同，这个传送门并没有被人为改动过且与网络中的其他传送门连接正常。但由于破损严重，此传送门暂时无法使用。
descriptions.en: We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. Unlike the previous one, this Gateway has not been altered in any obvious way and our scans indicate that it is still connected to the rest of the network. However, it is currently inoperable due to its poor condition.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为§HL-星团§!。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型§H纳米机器人§!建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活。除非我们能设法解除这一过程，不然我们将无法抵达L-星团。
descriptions.en:
We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the galaxy to another.

At some point after its initial construction its connection to the rest of the network was severed. It now offers only one valid destination - an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that our astronomers have designated the §HL-Cluster§!. Even more intriguing, the Gateway was built entirely by microscopic §HNanites§! of an unknown design.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

descriptions.zh:
我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系附近。此传送门是由我们从没见过的微型§H纳米机器人§!所建。

和之前的传送门不同，此传送门被人进行过大幅度的改动并和传送门网络断开了连接——现在该传送门只能通往一处位于我们星系之外的陌生星域，我们的天文学家将该星域称之为§HL-星团§!。

虽然此传送门有微弱的能源信号，但它被某种维护机制锁住了，因此无法启动。除非我们能设法停止维护机制，否则无法前往L-星团。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time near §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!. It appears to have been built entirely by microscopic §HNanites§! of an unknown design.

Unlike the previous structure, this Gateway has been significantly altered since its initial construction. Its connection to the rest of the network has been severed - instead, the only valid destination is an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that has been designated the §HL-Cluster§! by our astronomers.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.
